newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P raises Ajinomoto ratings to AA- and A-1+.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises Ajinomoto ratings to AA- and A-1+.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Monday that it had raised its long- and short-term ratings on Ajinomoto Co Inc to AA- and A-1+, respectively, from A+ and A-1.

The upgrades reflect the company's improved financial profile and well-established market position, supported by strong and steady earnings from its seasonings and by continued efforts at globalisation, S&P said in a statement.
S&P also said it upgraded the ratings of Ajinomoto USA Inc, a guaranteed subsidiary, and of Ajinomoto Capital (Europe) B.V., which benefits from a keepwell agreement with the parent.
S&P also said that it revised the outlook for the ratings to stable from positive, although it added that it expected Ajinomoto to be able to continue to grow and strengthen its business.
